extract_js: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="/remote-jobs/"], a[href*="/listings/"]')).map(a => ({ href: a.href.split('?')[0], title: a.innerText?.slice(0, 120) || '' })).filter(x => !x.href.includes('/search') && /\/(remote-jobs|listings)\/[a-z0-9-]{10,}/.test(x.href)).reduce((acc, x) => { if (!acc.find(y => y.href === x.href)) acc.push(x); return acc; }, []).slice(0, 20)
region_field: Every listing publishes a Region (e.g. 'Anywhere in the World', 'Asia Only') — use it for Remote restriction filter
rules: Search term with + for spaces; category pages when roles map cleanly
Check the Region field on each listing against the prompt's Remote restriction before including
Employers pay to post — low spam, but volume is lower than aggregators
Verify finalists with WebFetch; no login wall
notes: Largest dedicated remote board; strongest for engineering/design roles
